name: Mafia Lawyer
subtitle: you're not innocent until he says so
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 2 influence. -- If this card is destroyed in a battle your faction gains X influence, where X is the total strength of the opposing party.
flavor: "You have the right to an attorney. If you cannot afford an attorney, Vinny and Brick there will break your kneecaps."
notes: Catalog: 'When this card is destroyed during a battle'; card: 'If this card is destroyed in a battle'.

name: Postmortem Debenture
subtitle: secured by corporeal collateral
rules: COST – Pick a character in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character into your hand.
flavor: It took Jesse Doverspike 10 years to save the down payment for his funeral. It may take him 100 to pay off the debt.
notes: Catalog says 'EXTRA COST:'; card prints COST –.

name: Selective Gluttony
subtitle: tell the bakers we're going to need more cake

name: Shocking Reappearance
subtitle: allow me to speak posthumously
rules: COST – Play this only when you are blocking. Pick a character in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character into play under your control. Add the character to the blocking party.
flavor: "Moving on to the subject of our former chairman's unfortunate demise...Great Scott! Our former chairman!"
notes: Catalog timing is 'only while you are being attacked'; card says 'only when you are blocking'. Unsure if equivalent, so different. 'as a member of the blocking party' vs 'Add the character to the blocking party' is wording.

name: Resurrection Technician
subtitle: looks like the soup du jour was him, har har
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick a character in your discard pile. If you do, put that character into your hand.
flavor:
"My God! That's the chairman of Empire Impoverishments! Doesn't he realize he'll return as a necromorph?"
"It's what the will says. Pull the lever, Max."
notes: 'him' in the subtitle is underlined. Catalog says 'put it into your hand'; card says 'put that character into your hand'.
